name: design-testimonials
title: Design Testimonials
description: An editorial testimonial rotator: one large quote at a time, a soft oversized index behind it, a company badge, author line and arrow buttons. Quotes swap on a timer and words fade in one by one.
use: A marketing page wants social proof presented as a bold editorial moment rather than plain cards.
avoid: Huge type and a full-height section need room; on small screens the quote and index crowd each other.
a11y: Arrow buttons have no accessible names and auto-rotation cannot be paused; reduced-motion is ignored. (keyboard: partial, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A near-black panel holds a faint oversized numeral on the left, a vertical label and thin progress bar at the far left, and a large pale quote across the middle. Below sit a small pill badge, an author name and role, two round arrow buttons and a faint row of company names.
behaves: Every few seconds the quote, badge and author swap, with each word flipping up into place and the big numeral changing. Arrows step forward and back while a thin line fills as progress; the company ticker drifts endlessly.
customise: testimonials (quote, author, role, company), title, duration and className are props; the layout and motion are fixed in the source.
weight: moderate: A continuous ticker plus spring parallax and per-word motion on every slide.
demo: Quotes from Sarah Chen, Marcus Johnson and Priya Patel for Acme Corp, Vercel and Linear.
issues: The ghosted index and bottom ticker are so faint they almost vanish.
polishWhy: Strong editorial composition and smooth word reveal; the ghosted extras are almost too faint.
